cards.card_text: As Elisha watches, he cries out, "My father, my father, the chariots and horsemen of Israel!" And then he sees Elijah no more.
cards.verse_text: As Elisha watched, he cried out, “My father, my father, the chariots and horsemen of Israel!” And he saw Elijah no more. So taking hold of his own clothes, he tore them in two.

cards.card_text: He cries, "My father, my father, the chariots and horsemen of Israel!" Then Elisha tells the king to take a bow and some arrows, and the king does it.
cards.verse_text: When Elisha had fallen sick with the illness from which he would die, Jehoash king of Israel came down to him and wept over him, saying, “My father, my father, the chariots and horsemen of Israel!” Elisha told him, “Take a bow and some arrows.” So Jehoash took a bow and some arrows.
